candidates.rationale: Design-quality critique/polish review plus an offline deterministic anti-generic-design detector for an EXISTING P2P UI/game surface. REVIEW_AUTHORITY != IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORITY: it does not own routing, project scope, execution permission, evidence, Owner Gates or release. Only the critique/polish/bolder/quieter/layout/typeset review actions and the deterministic check are projected; init/live/audit/document/extract and the whole install, hook and browser-live surface are not.
candidates.security_notes: Apache-2.0 with upstream NOTICE retained. Only 23 unmodified files are vendored (.p2p/vendor/skill/pbakaus-impeccable-94b7f34). No npm install, no CLI, no hooks, no agent auto-activation wiring, no puppeteer/browser-live session, no cache or live-editing state. The vendored detector engines run on node builtins only; their optional HTML parser modules are not installed and the engine degrades deterministically instead.
activation_conditions: Explicit design-quality/critique request on an existing UI surface
Explicit authorization record before any execution
Explicit target file list; no repository-wide default scan
P2P retains implementation authority and Owner Gate control
